news.title: XAI reorganizes its engineering team ahead of SpaceX IPO - AOL
news.snippet: Several xAI cofounders left the company after it was acquired by SpaceX in Febru...
news.raw_snippet: Several xAI cofounders left the company after it was acquired by SpaceX in February. As Elon Musk's xAI merges more closely with SpaceX ahead of the space giant's blockbuster IPO, the AI company is undergoing yet another major overhaul to its engineering team, according to a memo viewed by Business Insider. On the compute team, the training performance of xAI's compute is "embarrassingly low," Nicolls said in the memo, and the company plans to improve it significantly in the next two months. Musk first reorganized the company in February, after xAI was acquired by SpaceX. Since January, eight of the engineers who helped found the company alongside Elon Musk have left the company, including cofounders Nordeen, Guodong Zhang, and Manuel Kroiss, who led Grok Code, and Toby Pohlen, who helped lead Macrohard, the company's computer use agent project. The company cut portions of its teams working on its video and image generation tool, Grok Imagine, and Macrohard, its AI agent project, earlier this year, Business Insider also previously reported.

news.title: The top priority for Adobe’s next CEO? Prepping for the ‘age of agents’  – Computerworld
news.snippet: For whomever is tapped next for the top job — the search is expected to take sev...
news.raw_snippet: For whomever is tapped next for the top job — the search is expected to take several months — the biggest priority will be reshaping Adobe’s products and strategy for the next wave of agentic AI, analysts said. “Ultimately, Adobe must evolve from a leader in creative tools to the system that connects content, context, and commerce in a world of real-time agentic interactions,” said Gerry Murray, research director at IDC. Narayen’s resignation, will “force the Adobe board to search for a leader who is not just a master of the subscription economy, but a visionary in the ‘agentic’ AI era,” Jim Lundy at Aragon Research said in a blog post last month. The key challenge for any successor will be “balancing Adobe’s professional-grade heritage with the increasing commoditization of creative tools driven by AI,” he said. To help Adobe adapt to these ongoing technological shifts, the next CEO will need to appoint a “central authority to align AI product strategy, platform architecture, and partnerships across business units” or lead the charge.

Almost 10 months after [Meta](https://www.cnbc.com/quotes/META/) spent [billions of dollars](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/06/10/zuckerberg-makes-metas-biggest-bet-on-ai-14-billion-scale-ai-deal.html) to bring in Scale AI’s Alexandr Wang as the centerpiece of [Mark Zuckerberg’s](https://www.cnbc.com/2017/04/18/mark-zuckerberg-facebook-act-two-augmented-reality.html) AI overhaul, the company finally revealed Muse Spark on Wednesday, its first new model since the transition. While rivals like OpenAI, Anthropic and [Google](https://www.cnbc.com/quotes/GOOGL/) have spearheaded the artificial intelligence boom with powerful models and popular chatbots as well as other services, Meta has been a hefty spender on AI but has yet to show any new revenue streams from it. [Zuckerberg](https://www.cnbc.com/mark-zuckerberg/) shook up his company’s strategy after the April release of[Llama 4](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/04/05/meta-debuts-new-llama-4-models-but-most-powerful-ai-model-is-still-to-come.html), which failed to captivate developers. ## [](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/09/metas-long-awaited-ai-model-is-finally-here-but-can-it-make-money.html)‘Crown jewel’. **WATCH**: [Why Meta’s new AI model, Muse Spark, is such a big deal](https://www.cnbc.com/video/2026/04/09/why-metas-new-ai-model-muse-spark-is-such-a-big-deal.html). *   [](https://www.facebook.com/cnbc/). *   [](https://www.twitter.com/cnbc/). *   [](https://www.linkedin.com/company/cnbc/). *   [](https://www.instagram.com/cnbc/). *   [](https://www.youtube.com/user/cnbc/). *   [About CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/about/). *   ![Image 16: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Icon](https://static-redesign.cnbcfm.com/dist/17269f1b6083fd5f61be.svg)[Your Privacy Choices](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/09/metas-long-awaited-ai-model-is-finally-here-but-can-it-make-money.html).
